title: The buildout advantage

captions.instagram:
As the Wiz chain grew, I built our own construction and prefabricated fixture manufacturing company.

Every new store is a buildout. Do it across a chain and building becomes a system. Today, BUILT® applies prefabrication to housing.

Save the 4 questions to ask about any buildout.

#Construction #Prefab #Retail

Where does your buildout cost leak?
captions.facebook:
Every new store is a construction project. As the Wiz grew, I built an in-house construction and prefabricated fixture company.

#Construction #SmallBusiness

Have you ever brought a key service in-house?
captions.linkedin:
A retail chain is a construction project on repeat.

Every new store needs a site, a lease, a design, fixtures and a build timed to opening day. As the Wiz chain grew, I built an in-house construction and prefabricated fixture manufacturing company.

Today, BUILT® takes prefabrication to housing: AI-powered, robotics-driven, cloud-based and laser-guided modular production.

Four questions for any buildout: Can we repeat it? Where does the cost leak? How long does it really take? Will every site look and work the same?

#Construction #Prefab

Which question costs your projects the most?
